problem.ownScope: A key can't reach lists outside your own scope.
problem.expiry: Pick an expiry date in the future.
problem.sendOnlyKind: Only API keys can be send-only keys.
problem.name: Give the key a name.
problem.integrationKey: This key belongs to an integration. Rotate it in Settings › Integrations, where the old key keeps working for 24 hours.
problem.rotateScope: This key reaches lists outside your scope, so you can't rotate it.
problem.deleteActive: Only expired or revoked keys can be deleted. Revoke it first.

problem.unknownPermission.note: permission: what was sent as a permission key

problem.sendOnlyPermission.message: A send-only key holds transactional:send and nothing else.
problem.sendOnlyPermission.note: transactional:send is a permission key, never translated

problem.sendOnlyLists: Send-only keys aren't limited by list; limit them to templates instead.
problem.preset: Pick a send-only key or an SMTP credential.

problem.template.message: There is no template with the ID {id}.
problem.template.note: id: a transactional template's ID, such as password-reset

problem.testAddress: “{address}” isn't an address or a pattern such as qa+*@acme.io.
problem.testLive: Allowed test addresses belong to test-mode keys; live keys deliver to everyone.

label.formerMember.note: who created a key, when that member has left the workspace

agent.needs.note: a denied agent call: permission is a key like campaigns:send

audit.scopeAllTemplates.note: audit summary parts of a new key, joined with ' · '

audit.scopeCategories.note: names: transactional categories' names, joined with commas

audit.rotated.note: masked, old: keys shown masked, such as rc_live_8f2c…a91d
